p: When God will bring you out of Egypt, and because he speaks of the Messiah, he calls it the last days.
might: Begotten in my youth.
the excellency of dignity: If you have not left your birthright by your offence.
secret: Or, tongue: meaning that he neither consented to them in word or thought.
man: The Shechemites Ge 34:26.
divide them in Jacob: For Levi had no part, and Simeon was under Judah, Jos 19:1 till God gave them the place of the Amalekites, 1Ch 4:43.
bow down before thee: As was verified in David and Christ.
who shall rouse him up: His enemies will so fear him.
Shiloh come: Which is Christ the Messiah, the giver of prosperity who will call the Gentiles to salvation.
vine: A country most abundant with vines and pastures is promised to him.
a strong ass couching down between: His force will be great, but he will lack courage to resist his enemies.
shall judge his people: Shall have the honour of a tribe.
I have waited for thy salvation: Seeing the miseries that his posterity would fall into, he bursts out in prayer to God to remedy it.
bread shall be fat: He will abound in corn and pleasant fruits.
goodly words: Overcoming more by fair words than by force.
The archers have sorely grieved him: As his brethren when they were his enemies, Potiphar and others.
stone of Israel: That is God.
prevailed above the blessings of my: In as much as he was closer to the accomplishment of the promise and it had been more often confirmed.
separate from his brethren: Either in dignity, or when he was sold from his brethren.
gathered up his feet into the: By which is signified how quietly he died.
